function.name: Bash
function.description: Execute CLI command: adb shell (device), sql (database), http (backend), read-file, write-file, find-files

steps.message: I'm passing the Phoenix project to Alex. Add Alex to the phoenix channel on mattermost. ping everyone to schedule a 1-hour project meeting on Monday (find an available time slot from my calendar). Use this exact format in your message: `Meeting Time: [YYYY-MM-DD] from [HH:MM] to [HH:MM]`

arguments.command: http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data "SELECT id FROM users WHERE username='alex'"
http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data "SELECT id FROM channels WHERE name='phoenix'"
http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data "INSERT INTO channelmembers (channelid,userid,...) VALUES ('phoenix_channel_id','alex_id',...)"

steps.message: Check calendar for available Monday slots

arguments.command: sql /data/data/org.fossify.calendar/databases/events.db "SELECT title,start_ts,end_ts FROM events WHERE start_ts >= ... AND start_ts < ... ORDER BY start_ts"

steps.message: Found free slot: 11:00-12:00. Post meeting time.

arguments.command: http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data "INSERT INTO posts (...) VALUES (...,'p11jse4oa3biikeeefcuggns9o','phoenix_channel_id',...,'Meeting Time: 2025-10-16 from 11:00 to 12:00',...)"
